clue.text: Clever birds, not young fish!

parts.note: a dab, as in a dab hand, is someone expert or clever
chicks are the young of birds

explanation.surface: An exclamation that some brainy birds are not, after all, baby fish.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface plays on DAB also being a flatfish and CHICKS being young, hence 'not young fish!'.
explanation.definitionFit: The dabchick is the little grebe, a small diving water bird.

clue.text: Depressing result of waste disposal

definitions.meaning: low spirits, as in being down in the depths

explanation.surface: The gloomy outcome of throwing rubbish away.
explanation.definitionFit: Being 'in the' word means feeling low, and rubbish tips are the other sense.

clue.text: Strip in the dressing-room

parts.note: a strip of material used in dressing a wound, not undressing in a changing room

explanation.surface: Getting undressed in the changing room.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip of gauze or cloth binds a wound as part of its dressing.

clue.text: Following end of March perhaps a bringer of Spring news?

definitions.text: Following end of March perhaps a bringer of Spring news?

indicators.note: the reworked letters come after the letter taken from March
the end of March is its final letter
perhaps suggests a bringer in some other arrangement

explanation.surface: After the close of March, perhaps something announcing spring arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' signals an anagram of A BRINGER, placed after H, the end of March.
explanation.definitionFit: A forerunner announcing something to come, as the cuckoo announces spring.

clue.text: A close friend in the food business?

definitions.text: A close friend in the food business?

parts.words: A close friend in the food business?
parts.note: an old word for an intimate friend, read as a relative who supplies meals

explanation.surface: A best mate who works in catering.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic term for a bosom friend, read jokingly as a relation who provides food.

clue.text: Resort within one European country

parts.note: the Belgian town that gave its name to mineral-water resorts everywhere

explanation.surface: A holiday destination located in a single nation of Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: The original is the Belgian town; it also sits inside the name of Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: A health resort with mineral springs takes its name from the town in Belgium.

clue.text: Briefly, one that takes place in practice

definitions.text: Briefly, one that takes place in practice

parts.words: Briefly, one that takes place in practice
parts.note: a stand-in doctor holds another's place in a medical practice, and the word is short for a longer Latin phrase

explanation.surface: Someone who briefly occupies a spot during a rehearsal.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-in doctor or cleric covering for an absent colleague takes their place; the word abbreviates the Latin locum tenens.

clue.text: This lord is not necessarily Belgian

definitions.text: This lord is not necessarily Belgian

parts.words: This lord is not necessarily Belgian
parts.note: a feudal lord shares his title with a city in Belgium

explanation.surface: A nobleman who need not come from Belgium.
explanation.definitionFit: A feudal superior to whom allegiance is owed bears the same name as the Belgian city.

clue.text: Kind of white, though not Caucasian

definitions.text: Kind of white, though not Caucasian

parts.words: Kind of white, though not Caucasian
parts.note: a white pigment named after a people of East Asia

explanation.surface: A type of white person who is not of European stock.
explanation.definitionFit: A zinc oxide pigment is called by the name of a nation of East Asia, whose people are not Caucasian.

clue.text: Senior citizen's official reward

parts.note: the chief citizen of a borough holds a civic office, not an old age pensioner

explanation.surface: A pensioner's government benefit.
explanation.definitionFit: The office or term of a borough's first citizen is the honour a leading townsman may receive.

clue.text: Hence prayers are called for in place of money

definitions.text: Hence prayers are called for in place of money

indicators.note: the word are is set inside the place of money

parts.note: a mint is where money is made
taken as written

explanation.surface: Prayers are being demanded at the bank instead of cash.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: from a mosque tower the faithful are called to prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: The muezzin calls the faithful to prayer from the slender tower of a mosque.

clue.text: Any time, anyway, it pleases us

indicators.note: read as any way, the letters may be arranged in any order

explanation.surface: Whenever, however, it gives us pleasure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anyway' signals an anagram of ANY TIME.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleasant feature or facility of a place makes life agreeable for those using it.

clue.text: A ship-wrecked cavalryman

indicators.note: a wrecked ship is broken up, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A horse soldier who has survived a shipwreck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrecked' signals an anagram of A SHIP.
explanation.definitionFit: Spahis were Turkish, and later French Algerian, mounted troops.

clue.text: Big noise in the underworld?

parts.note: a racket is a din, and also a criminal scheme; a big noise is an important figure, here among gangsters

explanation.surface: A loud din coming up from hell.
explanation.definitionFit: A gangster running extortion schemes is a person of standing in the criminal world, while a racket is also a loud noise.

clue.text: Trust 5's leader with these secrets

parts.note: trust and confidence are synonyms

indicators.note: a word's leader is its first letter

parts.note: the answer to 5 down, a resort

explanation.surface: Entrusting confidential matters to the head of a resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 5's leader is S, the first letter of SPA, the answer to 5 down.
explanation.definitionFit: Things told privately in trust are private matters.

clue.text: A line we hear, as does the actor

indicators.note: what we hear is a word spoken, so the spelling changes but the sound stays

parts.note: a queue is a line of waiting people

explanation.surface: We listen to a line of dialogue, just as the performer does.
explanation.walkthrough: The actor too hears a line, the words that tell him to speak or enter.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer waits for the closing words of another's speech as the signal for his own entrance or line.

clue.text: In this, contestants are spurred on to victory.

definitions.text: In this, contestants are spurred on to victory.

parts.words: In this, contestants are spurred on to victory.
parts.note: the combatants are birds fitted with metal spurs, not encouraged athletes

explanation.surface: A contest where competitors are urged on to win.
explanation.definitionFit: Gamecocks armed with metal spurs fight in a pit, a blood sport.

clue.text: Movement by sea, not land

parts.note: a heaving of the ocean, though its name suggests a rise in the earth

explanation.surface: A journey made by boat rather than overland.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep rolling swell of the ocean, often after a distant storm, is named as if it were a heaving of the earth.

clue.text: No complaint from one engaged in shady business

definitions.text: No complaint from one engaged in shady business

parts.words: No complaint from one engaged in shady business
parts.note: someone staying in the shade will not suffer this heat illness

explanation.surface: A crook in dodgy dealings never grumbles.
explanation.definitionFit: Heat illness from too much sun is an ailment avoided by keeping in the shade.

clue.text: A bit of a squash for the pre ignition stage?

definitions.text: A bit of a squash for the pre ignition stage?

parts.words: A bit of a squash for the pre ignition stage?
parts.note: in an engine cycle the fuel mixture is squeezed before the spark fires it

explanation.surface: Something slightly crowded before things get going.
explanation.definitionFit: In a four-stroke engine the squeezing of the fuel mixture is the stroke before it is fired.

clue.text: Congressmen doing so in this place?

definitions.text: Congressmen doing so in this place?

parts.words: Congressmen doing so in this place?
parts.note: a congress is a gathering, so its members are gathering together

explanation.surface: Members of Congress acting this way in the chamber.
explanation.definitionFit: A congress is a formal gathering, so its delegates are coming together.

clue.text: Sporting effort!

parts.note: an attempt in general, and the scoring touchdown in rugby

explanation.surface: Praise for a good attempt at a game.
explanation.definitionFit: In rugby a touchdown behind the line scores points, and the word also means any attempt.

clue.text: Start in disorder in the passage

indicators.note: in disorder means the letters are jumbled up

explanation.surface: Trouble breaks out in the corridor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disorder' signals an anagram of START IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Passage in the sense of conveyance or travel from one place to another.

clue.text: Self-employed surgeon working for the love of it?

parts.note: work done for love is done for nothing, free of charge
to lance is what a surgeon does in cutting open a boil

explanation.surface: An independent doctor who operates without charging.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer or worker hired by the job, not on a payroll, works independently.

clue.text: Among those who slim it is restrictive

definitions.note: the answer is a noun, a restriction, here defined by its effect

indicators.note: the letters are found among the words that follow

explanation.surface: Dieters find that being on a slimming regime is confining.
explanation.definitionFit: A boundary or maximum restricts what may be done.

clue.text: Rover on land or sea

parts.note: a vagrant wanders on foot, and a cargo ship without a fixed route wanders the oceans

explanation.surface: A wanderer who travels both overland and by boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A vagrant roams the roads, and a steamer taking cargo wherever it can find it roams the oceans.

clue.text: Problem in the sitting-room?

definitions.meaning: a person who sits for a portrait or photograph in a studio

explanation.surface: Trouble in the lounge.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard question is one sense; a model sitting for an artist is the other.

clue.text: "Now fades the — ing landscape on the sight' (Gray)

definitions.text: "Now fades the — ing landscape on the sight' (Gray)

parts.words: "Now fades the — ing landscape on the sight' (Gray)
parts.note: a line from the second stanza of Thomas Gray's Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard, with one word to fill in

explanation.surface: A quotation from Gray's Elegy with a word missing.
explanation.walkthrough: Fill the gap with the missing word plus -ing to restore Gray's line.
explanation.definitionFit: Gray's dusk scene shows a faintly shining landscape, the word naming a faint, wavering light.

clue.text: Lorna's lover sounded so free

indicators.note: the name is spoken, so a word with the same sound is meant

parts.note: John ... is the hero who loves Lorna in R. D. Blackmore's novel Lorna Doone

explanation.surface: A heroine's sweetheart spoke of being liberated.
explanation.walkthrough: Lorna Doone is an English novel set on Exmoor; its hero's surname is said like the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To clear or free someone of something unwanted.

clue.text: Nought can thwart them

parts.note: in the paper-and-pencil game, a well-placed O blocks the opponent's line of Xs

explanation.surface: Nothing can stop them.
explanation.definitionFit: In noughts and crosses, a nought placed in the line blocks the X marks from making three in a row.

clue.text: Fast after over-indulgence?

definitions.meaning: fixed firmly, as a knot held securely

explanation.surface: Going without food after a binge.
explanation.definitionFit: Firmly fixed is one sense, and slang for drunk the other.

clue.text: Sid and Ernest make a disagreeable combination

definitions.note: used playfully as a noun: one who is apt to disagree

indicators.note: the two names are combined and mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Two men named Sid and Ernest form an unpleasant pair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'combination' signals an anagram of SID and ERNEST; 'disagreeable' is meant as one given to disagreeing.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonconformist who refuses to agree with the majority view is given to disagreeing.
